name: closings
sql:
CREATE TABLE closings (
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	closed_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR, 
	shipped VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	pr VARCHAR, 
	gotchas JSON NOT NULL, 
	archive VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slug)
)

name: contract_commands
sql:
CREATE TABLE contract_commands (
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR, 
	argv JSON NOT NULL, 
	expect_exit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	timeout INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	approved_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	approved_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slug, command_id)
)

name: receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE receipts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	argv JSON NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	exit INTEGER, 
	duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	stdout_tail VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	stderr_tail VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR, 
	phase VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: review_dispositions
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_dispositions (
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"by" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, finding_id)
)

name: review_findings
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sources JSON NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	security BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	fix VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	verify VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evidence_kind VARCHAR, 
	evidence_cite VARCHAR, 
	"conflict" VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, finding_id)
)

name: review_outcomes
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_outcomes (
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"commit" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, finding_id)
)

name: review_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_runs (
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	base VARCHAR, 
	head VARCHAR, 
	depth VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	emphasis VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	weights JSON NOT NULL, 
	personas JSON NOT NULL, 
	models JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id)
)

name: task_attempts
sql:
CREATE TABLE task_attempts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	worker VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR, 
	at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: task_transitions
sql:
CREATE TABLE task_transitions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"before" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"after" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR, 
	at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: tasks
sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owned JSON NOT NULL, 
	base VARCHAR, 
	"commit" VARCHAR, 
	reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slug, task_id)
)

name: tickets
sql:
CREATE TABLE tickets (
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ticket VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	summary VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	branch VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	plan_first BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	issue INTEGER, 
	jira VARCHAR, 
	models JSON NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	investigations JSON NOT NULL, 
	validated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slug)
)
